# DOT Hazmat Function Specific Training: Shipping Papers

> 2-hour online function-specific training for hazmat employers and employees who prepare and use shipping papers, under DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations 49 CFR Part 172 Subpart C. Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 2 hours; 2 modules, 4 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.2 CEU
- Price: $39.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, audio narration; SCORM, virtual instructor-led and on-site formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Prerequisites: none
- Certificate: downloadable on passing; valid 3 years (recurrent training at least every three years)
- Context: improperly describing hazmat on shipping papers is one of the most frequently cited HMR violations

## Basic description sequence
Identification number, proper shipping name, hazard class or division, packing group (if any). Example: UN1203, Gasoline, 3, PG II.

## Lessons
1. Regulatory Overview
2. Preparation of Shipping Papers (qualifying documents, general requirements and exceptions, listing hazmat with non-hazardous materials)
3. Additional Description Requirements (special permits, air, rail, highway and vessel entries, hazardous substances, marine pollutants)
4. Shipper's Certification (certification, emergency response information, hazardous waste manifest, recordkeeping)

## Who should take it
Hazmat employees who prepare or handle shipping papers; employers; workers who package, label or document shipments; highway, rail, air and vessel transport personnel; safety managers and compliance officers.
